Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The old lighthouse stood tall on the rugged cliffs, its beacon piercing through the misty evening air. Far below, the waves crashed against the rocks, a constant reminder of the sea's power. Tom, a seasoned sailor, gazed out at the horizon, his weathered face reflecting years of seafaring adventures.As dusk descended, Tom recalled his most daring voyage, navigating through treacherous waters to save a stranded ship. His courage and skill had earned him respect among sailors worldwide. Yet, despite his accomplishments, Tom remained humble, always ready to lend a hand to those in need.The lighthouse keeper, an elderly man named James, joined Tom on the cliffside. Together, they watched as the stars emerged in the darkening sky, a silent tribute to the vastness of the ocean and the courage of those who sailed its waters.What is Tom's occupation from the following options?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (A seasoned sailor) है।
